---
applyTo: "godot/**/*.gd,godot/**/*.tscn,godot/**/*.godot"
---
Godot owns the fullscreen cage, native interactive windows, avatar state, animation, cameras, and cutscenes. Use typed HTTP/JSON contracts to communicate with FastAPI. Do not duplicate backend business logic in GDScript. Default tablet control-plane targets to loopback and preserve a rendering fallback until Samsung Vulkan smoke tests pass.
